items.name: RetroArch
items.description: 一站式复古游戏模拟器。该项目是 libretro 官方开发的跨平台模拟器，可动态加载各类游戏机模拟器和游戏引擎。它提供多种着色器、即时存档、手柄操作和视频录制等功能，支持 Windows、Linux、macOS、Android、iOS 以及 PS、Xbox、任天堂主机等平台。
items.description_en: One-stop Retro Game Emulator.This project is an official cross-platform emulator developed by Libretro, which can dynamically load various console emulators and game engines. It provides multiple functions like shaders, instant saving, controller operation, and video recording, and supports platforms such as Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, iOS, as well as PS, Xbox, and Nintendo consoles.

items.name: DeskBox
items.description: 让 Windows 桌面井然有序。这是一款开源的 Windows 桌面整理工具，为桌面加入具有 Windows 原生质感的文件格子和日常工具。它内置待办、随记、搜索、天气和音乐控制等小组件，支持映射现有文件夹、自动整理桌面文件和 QuickLook 预览等功能。
items.description_en: Keep Windows Desktop Organized.This is an open-source Windows desktop organization tool that adds file grids with a native Windows aesthetic and daily tools to the desktop. It includes built-in widgets such as to-do lists, note-taking, search, weather, and music control. It supports features like mapping existing folders, automatically organizing desktop files, and QuickLook previews.

items.name: DiscordChatExporter
items.description: Discord 聊天记录导出工具。这是一款用 C# 编写的 Discord 消息导出工具，可将私信、群聊和频道消息导出为文件，支持 HTML、TXT、CSV、JSON 输出格式，并保留 Markdown、附件、表情等内容，导出结果可离线查看。
items.description_en: Discord Chat History Export Tool.This is a C#-based Discord message export tool that can export direct messages, group chats, and channel messages into files, supporting output formats like HTML, TXT, CSV, and JSON, while preserving content such as Markdown, attachments, and emojis, with exported results viewable offline

items.name: tubatools
items.description: Windows 电脑硬件检测工具。该项目是采用 C# 和 WinUI 3 开发的 Windows 装机工具箱，集成硬件检测、装机助手、网络诊断和垃圾清理等功能。
items.description_en: Windows PC Hardware Detection Tool.This project is a Windows system toolbox developed with C# and WinUI 3, integrating functions such as hardware detection, system installation assistant, network diagnosis, and junk cleaning.

items.name: EUI-NEO
items.description: 轻量级 C++ 跨平台 UI 框架。这是一个面向 C++ 应用的轻量级声明式 UI 框架，无需引入 WebView 或脚本运行时。它支持 GLFW/SDL2 窗口后端和 OpenGL/Vulkan 渲染后端，内置布局、动画、事件、异步、网络请求和图片加载等功能，以及键盘、串口等可选模块。
items.description_en: Lightweight Cross-Platform UI Framework for C++.This is a lightweight declarative UI framework for C++ applications, which doesn't require introducing WebView or script runtime. It supports GLFW/SDL2 window backends and OpenGL/Vulkan rendering backends, and features built-in layout, animation, event, asynchronous, network request, and image loading, along with optional modules like keyboard and serial port.

items.name: fooyin
items.description: 可自由定制界面的音乐播放器。这是一款界面可自由定制的桌面音乐播放器，可从空白画布或预设布局中自由编排界面。它支持 FLAC、MP3、Opus 等主流音频格式，提供无缝播放、标签编辑、音频转换、歌词同步显示和网络电台等功能，还可通过插件和内置的 FooScript 脚本扩展功能。
items.description_en: Music Player with Customizable Interface.This is a desktop music player with a fully customizable interface, allowing users to freely arrange the interface from a blank canvas or preset layouts. It supports mainstream audio formats like FLAC, MP3, Opus, and offers functions such as seamless playback, tag editing, audio conversion, synchronized lyrics display, and internet radio. It can also extend features via plugins and the built-in FooScript scripting.

items.name: casos
items.description: 开箱即用的云操作系统。该项目是基于 Kubernetes 构建的云操作系统，将 API Server、Controller Manager 和 Scheduler 集成到单个可执行文件。无需搭建集群和编写 YAML，即可拥有一个带 Web 管理界面和应用商店的云操作系统。
items.description_en: Out-of-the-Box Cloud Operating System.This project is a cloud operating system built on Kubernetes, integrating the API Server, Controller Manager, and Scheduler into a single executable file. You can have a cloud operating system with a web management interface and app store without setting up a cluster or writing YAML.

items.name: dbmate
items.description: 轻量级数据库迁移工具。这是一款用 Go 编写的数据库迁移工具，可让数据库结构在多名开发者和生产服务器之间保持同步。它开箱即用、纯 SQL 编写迁移脚本，不绑定任何编程语言或框架，支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite 和 ClickHouse 等数据库。
items.description_en: Lightweight Database Migration Tool.This is a Go-based database migration tool that keeps database schemas in sync across multiple developers and production servers. It is ready-to-use out of the box, uses pure SQL for migration scripts, is language and framework agnostic, and supports databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, and ClickHouse.

items.name: devpod
items.description: 开源的云开发环境。该项目是基于 DevContainer 标准的客户端开发环境工具，可在本地、K8s、远程机器或云服务器中创建一致的容器化开发环境。它支持 SSH、VSCode 和 JetBrains 接入，并提供预构建、闲置自动关机、凭据同步等功能。
items.description_en: Open-Source Cloud Development Environment.This project is a client-side development environment tool based on the DevContainer standard, which can create consistent containerized development environments on local machines, K8s, remote machines, or cloud servers. It supports access via SSH, VSCode, and JetBrains, and provides functions such as pre-building, automatic idle shutdown, and credential synchronization

items.name: hister
items.description: 个人浏览记录搜索引擎。该项目是用 Go 开发的个人搜索引擎，可全文检索你浏览过的网页和本地文件，支持 Firefox/Chrome 扩展自动收录新访问的页面、浏览器历史导入、字段过滤、通配符和语义搜索等功能。
items.description_en: Personal Browsing History Search Engine.This project is a personal search engine developed in Go, which can perform full-text search on the web pages and local files you have browsed, and supports features such as automatic inclusion of newly accessed pages by Firefox/Chrome extensions, import of browser history, field filtering, wildcard and semantic search

items.name: droidVNC-NG
items.description: Android 远程桌面工具。这是一款专为局域网设计的远程查看和控制 Android 设备的工具，打开浏览器即可操控手机，无需 Root 权限。支持鼠标键盘操作、剪贴板共享、文件传输和屏幕缩放等功能。
items.description_en: Android Remote Desktop Tool.This is a tool designed for local area networks to remotely view and control Android devices. You can operate the phone by opening a browser, and it doesn't require root access. It supports functions such as mouse and keyboard operation, clipboard sharing, file transfer, and screen scaling

items.name: grimmory
items.description: 自托管的电子书漫画有声书库。这是一款开源的数字书库，支持管理电子书、漫画和有声书，可在浏览器里阅读、标注和查看进度，并提供智能书架、全文搜索、元数据抓取和一键发送到 Kindle 等功能。
items.description_en: Self-hosted E-book, Comic, and Audiobook Library.This is an open-source digital library that supports managing e-books, comics, and audiobooks. It enables reading, annotating, and tracking progress in the browser, and provides features such as smart bookshelves, full-text search, metadata scraping, and one-click sending to Kindle.

items.name: flint-chart
items.description: 为 AI 而生的可视化语言。这是一种面向 AI 智能体的可视化中间语言，可通过简洁、人类可编辑的代码生成美观、准确的图表。它能自动处理布局、坐标轴、标签等参数，推导出更合适的图表配置，并提供 MCP 服务方便智能体直接调用。
items.description_en: A Visual Language Designed for AI.This is a visual intermediate language for AI agents. It can generate beautiful and accurate charts through concise, human-editable code. It automatically handles parameters such as layout, axes, and labels, derives more appropriate chart configurations, and provides MCP services for agents to call directly.

items.name: gpu.js
items.description: 让 JavaScript 代码跑在 GPU 上。这是一个 JavaScript 的 GPU 通用计算加速库，能够将简单的 JavaScript 函数转换为适配不同后端的 Shader Code，实现在 GPU 上并行执行，从而显著提升计算速度。
items.description_en: Running JavaScript Code on the GPU.This is a general-purpose GPU computing acceleration library for JavaScript. It can convert simple JavaScript functions into Shader Code suitable for different backends, enabling parallel execution on the GPU and significantly improving computing speed

items.name: LinearAbiltyCastingThreeJS
items.description: 炫酷的技能特效沙盒。这是一个用 Three.js 和 GLSL 实现的技能特效沙盒，内置冰霜、闪电、陨石、光束和陷阱 5 种技能，所有效果均由程序生成，并支持箭头瞄准、点击释放、暂停调整等功能。
items.description_en: Cool Skill Effects Sandbox.This is a skill effects sandbox implemented with Three.js and GLSL, featuring 5 skills: frost, lightning, meteor, beam, and trap. All effects are generated procedurally, and it supports functions like arrow aiming, click-to-release, and pause adjustment.

items.name: prehistoric-animal-museum
items.description: 陪孩子在线逛史前动物博物馆。该项目是专为儿童设计的 3D 史前动物博物馆，收录了海陆空 18 种动物，支持旋转缩放、中英双语旁白和设置探险形象等功能。
items.description_en: Accompanying Kids to Virtually Explore the Prehistoric Animal Museum Online.This project is a 3D prehistoric animal museum designed specifically for children, featuring 18 kinds of animals from the sea, land, and air, and supporting functions such as rotation, zooming, bilingual (Chinese and English) narration, and setting exploration avatars.

items.name: ZenConverter
items.description: 开源的安卓文件格式转换工具。这是一款无广告、免费的 Android 文件格式转换工具，所有转换都在手机本地完成，文件无需上传到服务器，支持音视频、图片、PDF、字体和字幕等文件。
items.description_en: Open-Source Android File Format Converter.This is an ad-free, free Android file format conversion tool. All conversions are carried out locally on the mobile phone, with no need to upload files to servers. It supports audio/video, image, PDF, font, subtitle and other types of files.

items.name: airllm
items.description: 仅需 4GB 显存就能跑 70B 大模型。这是一个通过分层加载大幅降低推理显存占用的 Python 库，无需量化、蒸馏或剪枝，仅需 4GB 显存即可运行 70B 大模型。它支持 Llama 3.x、Qwen3、DeepSeek 等主流模型，并提供预取加速、8bit/4bit 量化和 macOS 支持。
items.description_en: Running 70B Large Models with Just 4GB VRAM.This is a Python library that drastically reduces inference VRAM usage via hierarchical loading. It can run 70B large models with only 4GB VRAM without quantization, distillation, or pruning. It supports mainstream models such as Llama 3.x, Qwen3, DeepSeek, and offers prefetch acceleration, 8bit/4bit quantization, and macOS support.

items.name: PYAS
items.description: Python 写的杀毒软件。这是一款用 Python 和 C++ 开发的 Windows 杀毒软件，通过机器学习和行为监控拦截威胁，支持 PE 文件扫描、云端检测、签名校验，以及文件、进程和注册表等系统防护功能。
items.description_en: Antivirus Software Written in Python.This is a Windows antivirus software developed with Python and C++ that intercepts threats through machine learning and behavior monitoring, supporting PE file scanning, cloud detection, signature verification, and system protection functions such as files, processes, and registries

items.name: ServerKit
items.description: 轻量级的服务器控制面板。这是一款采用 Flask 和 React 构建的服务器管理面板，运行时仅占 180MB 内存，可统一管理网站、数据库和 Docker 等服务。它内置 100 多个一键安装应用模板，支持多机监控、HTTPS 证书自动续签、定时备份和文件管理器等功能。
items.description_en: Lightweight Server Control Panel.This is a server management panel built with Flask and React. It only occupies 180MB of memory during runtime and can uniformly manage services such as websites, databases, and Docker. It comes with over 100 one - click installation application templates and supports functions like multi - machine monitoring, automatic renewal of HTTPS certificates, scheduled backups, and a file manager.

items.name: watermarks-remover
items.description: 清除 AI 水印的工具。这是一款用于删除 AI 生成内容里的来源标记和隐形水印的工具，可处理 Claude、Gemini、OpenAI 等水印，支持文本、图片、文档和视频等多种内容类型。
items.description_en: Tool to Remove AI Watermarks.This is a tool designed to remove source marks and invisible watermarks from AI-generated content, which can handle watermarks from Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, etc., and supports various content types such as text, images, documents, and videos.

items.name: floral-notepaper
items.description: 轻量优雅的跨平台桌面便签工具。该项目是基于 Tauri 2 和 React 构建的桌面便签工具，按下全局快捷键即可随时唤出便签窗口。它支持 Markdown 编辑与实时预览、小窗多开、磁贴模式等功能，适用于 Windows 和 macOS 系统。
items.description_en: Lightweight and Elegant Cross-Platform Desktop Sticky Note Tool.This project is a desktop sticky note tool built with Tauri 2 and React. It allows you to call up the sticky note window at any time by pressing global hotkeys. It supports features like Markdown editing with real-time preview, multiple small windows, and tile mode, and is compatible with Windows and macOS systems.

items.name: tuicr
items.description: 方便在终端里做代码审查的工具。这是一款支持 Vim 快捷键的终端代码审查工具，可在命令行中连续浏览所有变更并添加评论。评论可作为正式 Review 一键提交至 GitHub、GitLab 或 Bitbucket，也能导出为 Markdown，兼容 git、jj 和 Mercurial。
items.description_en: A Tool for Convenient Code Review in Terminal.This is a terminal-based code review tool that supports Vim keybindings, allowing continuous browsing of all changes and adding comments in the command line. Comments can be submitted as formal reviews to GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket with a single click, and it can also be exported to Markdown, being compatible with git, jj, and Mercurial

items.name: WindInput
items.description: Rust 写的开源中文输入法。这是一款用 Rust 编写的轻量级中文输入法，资源占用低、启动速度快，支持五笔 86、五笔拼音混输、全拼和双拼。
items.description_en: Open-Source Chinese Input Method Written in Rust.This is a lightweight Chinese input method written in Rust, which has low resource consumption, fast startup speed, and supports Wubi 86, mixed Wubi-Pinyin input, full pinyin, and double pinyin.

items.name: dashi-ppt-skill
items.description: 让 AI Agent 帮你做 PPT。这是一个能够生成可编辑 PPT 的技能包，把文档丢给 Agent 即可生成网页版 PPT，支持在浏览器里直接修改文字、换图片、调布局，以及一键导出为可编辑的 PPT 文件。
items.description_en: Let AI Agents Help You Create PPTs.This is a skill package that can generate editable PPTs. You can throw documents to the agent to create web-based PPTs, which support directly modifying text, changing images, adjusting layouts in the browser, and one-click exporting to editable PPT files.

items.name: effective-html
items.description: 让 AI 用 HTML 画原型和图表。该项目能够让 AI 智能体生成可直接在浏览器中打开的 HTML 可视化内容，包括报告、交互式原型、计划路线图、架构和流程图等。
items.description_en: AI-Powered HTML Prototyping and Chart Generation.This project enables AI agents to generate HTML visualizations that can be opened directly in browsers, including reports, interactive prototypes, strategic roadmaps, architectures, and flowcharts, etc.

items.name: i-have-adhd
items.description: 让 AI 直接说重点的技能。该项目以《The Adult ADHD Tool Kit》一书的方法为准则，制定了 10 条输出规则，包括行动优先、步骤编号、列表不超过 5 项等，并省去开场白、回顾和客套结尾，让 AI 直接输出重点。
items.description_en: Skills to Make AI Get to the Point Directly.This project formulates 10 output rules based on the method in the book *The Adult ADHD Tool Kit*, including prioritizing actions, numbering steps, keeping lists to no more than 5 items, etc., and omits opening remarks, reviews, and polite closings to make AI output key points directly

items.name: ian-xiaohei-illustrations
items.description: 为文章生成手绘配图的技能。该项目是用于生成中文文章配图的 Agent 技能，能够提炼文章中的判断、流程、状态和隐喻，画成白底、手绘、有趣和清爽的 16:9 正文配图。
items.description_en: Skill to Generate Hand-drawn Illustrations for Articles.This project is an Agent skill for generating hand-drawn illustrations for Chinese articles. It can extract judgments, processes, states, and metaphors from the article, and create 16:9 body illustrations that are white-background, hand-drawn, interesting, and crisp

items.name: Crisp
items.description: 免费的 macOS 外接显示器管理工具。这是一款用于控制外接显示器的 macOS 菜单栏应用，所有功能完全免费。支持调节亮度/音量/排列、HiDPI 缩放、配置预设、虚拟显示器等功能。
items.description_en: Free macOS External Display Management Tool.This is a macOS menu bar application for controlling external displays, completely free of charge. It supports functions such as brightness/volume/arrangement adjustment, HiDPI scaling, preset configuration, virtual displays, etc.

items.name: MacPacker
items.description: 免费的 macOS 压缩包管理器。这是一款免费开源的 macOS 压缩包管理工具，无需解压即可像浏览文件夹一样查看内容、直接拖出所需文件，支持 40 多种压缩包和磁盘镜像格式。
items.description_en: Free macOS Compression Package Manager.This is a free and open-source macOS compression package management tool. It enables you to view contents as if browsing a folder without extraction, and you can directly drag out the required files. It supports over 40 compression package and disk image formats.

items.name: book-to-skill
items.description: 把技术书变成智能体技能。这是一款可以将技术书籍和文档转化成 Agent 技能的工具，让 AI 编程助手按需加载并基于原书内容回答。它会自动生成 SKILL.md、按章节拆分的文件、术语表和速查表，让 Token 消耗比直接把整本书塞进上下文少 20-50 倍，支持 PDF、EPUB、DOCX 和 Markdown 等文件。
items.description_en: Turning Technical Books into Agent Skills.This is a tool that converts technical books and documents into Agent skills, enabling AI coding assistants to load them on demand and answer based on the original book content. It automatically generates SKILL.md, chapter - split files, glossaries, and cheat sheets, reducing token consumption by 20 - 50 times compared to directly including the whole book in the context, and supports formats such as PDF, EPUB, DOCX, and Markdown.

items.name: deepseek-harness
items.description: DeepSeek 开源的智能体框架。该项目是 DeepSeek 官方开源的智能体框架，采用一切皆插件的设计理念，模型适配器、工具、会话日志和智能体循环都是可替换的插件，并提供开箱即用的 Web 界面。
items.description_en: DeepSeek Open-Source Agent Framework.This project is an open-source agent framework officially released by DeepSeek. It adopts a plug-in-everything design philosophy, where model adapters, tools, conversation logs, and agent loops are all replaceable plugins, and it offers an out-of-the-box web interface.

items.name: oh-my-pi
items.description: 把 IDE 能力接入终端编程智能体。这是一个采用 TypeScript 和 Rust 开发的终端 AI 编码智能体，由开源项目 Pi 演化而来，主打把 IDE 能力引入智能体。它将 LSP 深度集成到每次代码修改中，重命名会同步更新所有引用，还能调用 lldb、dlv、debugpy 等调试器定位问题，适用于 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 系统。
items.description_en: Bringing IDE Capabilities to Terminal Programming Agents.This is a terminal AI coding agent developed with TypeScript and Rust, evolved from the open-source project Pi, focusing on bringing IDE capabilities to the agent. It deeply integrates LSP into every code modification, where renaming will synchronously update all references, and it can also call debuggers like lldb, dlv, debugpy to locate issues, and is compatible with macOS, Linux, and Windows systems.

items.name: pipecat
items.description: 实时语音 AI 智能体的框架。这是一个用于构建实时语音和多模态对话智能体的 Python 框架，可将语音识别、大模型和语音合成编排成可组合的处理管道。它通过 WebSocket 或 WebRTC 实现超低延迟交互，每条管道即一个 Agent，支持任务交接、并行分发和跨进程分布式部署等多智能体协作方式，适用于语音助手、在线客服和陪伴应用等场景。
items.description_en: The Framework of Real-time Speech AI Agents.This is a Python framework designed for building real-time speech and multimodal dialogue agents. It can orchestrate speech recognition, large models, and speech synthesis into composable processing pipelines. It enables ultra-low latency interaction through WebSocket or WebRTC. Each pipeline functions as an Agent, supporting multi-agent collaboration modes like task handover, parallel distribution, and cross-process distributed deployment, and is applicable to scenarios such as voice assistants, online customer service, and companion applications.

items.name: plannotator
items.description: 批注 AI 编码智能体输出的工具。这是一款本地运行的 AI 编程智能体审阅工具。当 AI 输出计划或写完代码后，它会自动在浏览器中打开审查界面，支持批注计划、评论 diff 和 PR，反馈会直接回传给 Agent 执行，兼容 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot CLI 等。
items.description_en: Tool for Annotating AI Coding Agent Output.This is a locally run AI coding agent review tool. When the AI outputs a plan or finishes writing code, it automatically opens a review interface in the browser, supports annotating plans, commenting on diffs and PRs, and feedback is directly sent back to the agent for execution, compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, etc.

items.name: bee-write-back
items.description: 用树莓派自制一台数字打字机。该项目是用树莓派、5.5 英寸屏幕和机械键盘制作的专注写作设备，作者最初是为了解决睡前写日记助眠、又不想被旧日记勾起情绪的困扰而打造，成本约 200 美元。
items.description_en: Building a Digital Typewriter with Raspberry Pi.This project is a dedicated writing device made with a Raspberry Pi, a 5.5-inch screen, and a mechanical keyboard. The author originally created it to solve the problem of helping with sleep aid when writing diaries before bed and avoiding being affected by old diaries, with a cost of about $200.

items.name: IHaskell
items.description: 在 Jupyter 中运行 Haskell 代码。该项目能让你在 Jupyter Notebook 中交互式编写和运行 Haskell 代码，支持 GHC 8.4-9.14 所有版本。它提供 Hackage、源码编译、Docker、Nix 等多种安装方式，也可以通过浏览器体验。
items.description_en: Running Haskell Code in Jupyter.This project allows you to interactively write and run Haskell code in Jupyter Notebook, supporting all versions of GHC from 8.4 to 9.14. It provides multiple installation methods such as Hackage, source code compilation, Docker, Nix, etc., and can also be experienced through a browser

items.name: Lithe-IDEA
items.description: 轻量级的 Java IDE 编程工具。这是一款面向 Java 和 Spring Boot 开发者的轻量级 IDE，运行时内存占用仅 300-400 MB，支持全局搜索、代码跳转、Maven、断点调试、数据库管理等功能，适用于 macOS 和 Windows 系统。
items.description_en: Lightweight Java IDE Programming Tool.This is a lightweight IDE aimed at Java and Spring Boot developers, with a runtime memory usage of only 300-400 MB, supporting functions such as global search, code jumping, Maven, breakpoint debugging, database management, etc., and applicable to macOS and Windows systems

items.name: mhabit
items.description: 跨平台的习惯养成应用。这是一款用于培养和跟踪个人习惯的应用，通过每日打卡帮助用户更高效地养成习惯。它不只统计连续打卡天数，还提供成长曲线量化长期坚持情况，支持 WebDAV 多端同步、自定义颜色和习惯分组，适用于 Android、iOS、Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。
items.description_en: Cross-Platform Habit-Tracking App.This is an app for cultivating and tracking personal habits. It helps users develop habits more efficiently through daily check-ins. It not only counts consecutive check-in days but also provides a growth curve to quantify long-term persistence. It supports WebDAV multi-platform synchronization, custom colors, and habit grouping, and is applicable to Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux platforms.

items.name: newtab-naivetab
items.description: 可视化键盘新标签页。该项目是用键盘布局展示书签的浏览器插件，可将书签和指令绑定到按键，在新标签页中按下对应按键即可直达网站。它内置多种实用小组件，支持拖拽布局、专注模式和云同步，兼容 Chrome、Edge 与 Firefox。
items.description_en: Visual Keyboard New Tab.This project is a browser extension that displays bookmarks using a keyboard layout. It can bind bookmarks and commands to keys, allowing direct access to websites by pressing the corresponding keys in the new tab. It has built-in practical widgets, supports drag-and-drop layout, focus mode, and cloud synchronization, and is compatible with Chrome, Edge, and Firefox.
